instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to learn about logical reasoning.

atoms.b: Logical reasoning is when we think ((++sensibly angrily)) to work things out.
We can look at something that has happened and think about the ((++rules fools)) we know to explain it.

atoms.a: Lara is feeling sick after she ate raw cookie dough. What rule do you know that explains why?
Lara puts her hand too close to the fireplace and gets burnt. What rule do you know that explains why?
Lara has hurt her head after falling off her bike. What rule did she not follow that explains why?
b: ++Wear a helmet when riding a bike.
Ride your bike on dangerous roads.
Ride your bike when the roads are icy.

atoms.a: Lara has lost her dad in a busy shopping centre. What rule did she not follow that explains why?
b: ++Hold an adult’s hand in busy areas.
Run off without telling an adult.
Always get distracted by toy shops.

instruction.text: Is the statement true or false?

atoms.a: Logical reasoning is when we think sensibly.
We can use the rules we know to work out why things happen.
